# The QML type the panel instantiates. In-process on purpose: no daemon, no bus, no listener.
# The plugin class is generated by qt_add_qml_module - do not hand-write one, it will collide.

qt_add_qml_module(cybou-presence-qml
    URI org.cybou.presence
    VERSION 1.0
    PLUGIN_TARGET cybou-presence-qml
    NO_PLUGIN_OPTIONAL
    SOURCES
        QmlTypes.cpp
        QmlTypes.h
)

target_link_libraries(cybou-presence-qml PRIVATE Qt6::Qml cybou-presence)
